findings.why_it_matters: A tool or reader that walks the heading outline places the USAGE clause (and its syntax and general rules) inside the SYNCHRONIZED clause section, so a section lookup for 5.14 or a citation anchor derived from the outline resolves wrongly.
findings.note: Heading at the wrong level: its siblings 5.13 THE SYNCHRONIZED CLAUSE (page 276) and 5.15 THE VALUE CLAUSE (page 280) are '##' with '###' subsections, but 5.14 is '###' and its subsections 5.14.1-5.14.4 are '####', so 5.14 nests under 5.13 in the document outline.
